holes_found.description: P5 'four stations' count is internally inconsistent with the subsequent enumeration. The text states discrimination is 'concentrated at four stations' then names five distinct station identifiers across the enumeration: LER (explicitly), HAD/ESK (slash-pair = 2 stations), NGK (marginal), and SNK (explicitly) = 5. A careful reader can reconstruct the intended four (LER + HAD + ESK + SNK, with NGK as a boundary-case extra not counted in the four), but 'the three corrected out-of-band stations HAD/ESK' is also ambiguous — it says 'three' but names only two station codes (HAD, ESK), relying on the reader to realize LER was already named separately and counts as the third. The prose creates a 'four stations' claim that first-reading arithmetic contradicts. No argument error — the underlying discrimination point is correct and the supporting detail is sound.
holes_found.recommendation: Clarify to: 'concentrated at four stations: LER at the high-latitude end (CGM 62°, clearly outside the band), HAD and ESK (CGM 53.6° and 57.5°, the other two corrected out-of-band stations — together the three form the ≤30%-ceiling cohort), and SNK at the low-latitude end (CGM 33°, an in-band edge case where coverage is the dominant signal); NGK (CGM 51.85°) sits on the upper boundary and is pre-registered as a marginal boundary case.' This makes the four explicit (LER, HAD, ESK, SNK) and separates NGK's marginal status clearly.
